question: For instances in availability zone "flare3", show the instance UUID, its display name, its VM state, and the running sum of the instance IDs within each VM-state group ordered by instance ID (using the instance extra record matched by UUID). Also include a formatted output where the VM state is not repeated if it is the same as the previous row, and include a subtotal row for each VM state. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    i.uuid AS instance_uuid,
    i.display_name AS display_name,
    i.vm_state AS vm_state,
    i.id AS instance_id,
    SUM(i.id) OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.vm_state
      ORDER BY i.id
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_sum
  FROM instances AS i
  JOIN instance_extra AS ie
    ON ie.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  WHERE i.availability_zone = 'flare3'
),
formatted AS (
  SELECT
    instance_uuid,
    display_name,
    vm_state,
    instance_id,
    running_sum,
    CASE
      WHEN vm_state = LAG(vm_state) OVER (ORDER BY vm_state, instance_id)
      THEN ''
      ELSE vm_state
    END AS vm_state_formatted
  FROM base
),
subtotals AS (
  SELECT
    vm_state,
    SUM(instance_id) AS subtotal
  FROM base
  GROUP BY vm_state
)
SELECT
  f.instance_uuid,
  f.display_name,
  f.vm_state_formatted,
  f.running_sum,
  NULL AS subtotal
FROM formatted AS f
UNION ALL
SELECT
  NULL,
  NULL,
  CONCAT(s.vm_state, ' subtotal'),
  NULL,
  s.subtotal
FROM subtotals AS s
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN subtotal IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  vm_state_formatted,
  running_sum
